calls.video_title: Invest $580 a Month Into These ETFs. Retire a Millionaire
calls.thesis: Conditional: for investors in their 60s while treasuries yield >5% — a guaranteed 5% exceeds the 4% withdrawal rule; buy the treasury itself and hold to maturity, not a bond fund.
calls.bull_case: Guaranteed 5% interest alone beats the 4% rule; 2008-style crash: bonds gained 6.9% while market fell 36.8%.
calls.bear_case: Holds 0% bonds personally at all other ages; bonds fell 13.1% in 2022 when rates jumped.
